import os
from cyhole import Helius

api_key = os.getenv("HELIUS_API_KEY")
if not api_key:
    raise ValueError("HELIUS_API_KEY environment variable not set")

wallet_address = "YOUR_WALLET_ADDRESS_HERE"

helius = Helius(api_key=api_key)
assets = helius.get_assets(owner=wallet_address)

print(f"Digital Assets owned by {wallet_address}:")
for asset in assets:
    print(asset)
